project.title: IDS Data Systems (New Democratic Party)

role_overview.summary: IDS Data Systems is a Canadian IT managed services provider engaged by the New Democratic Party of Canada to manage a concurrent cloud transformation covering both unified communications and a bespoke server workload migration. Christian served as Cloud Architect across two simultaneous workstreams, migrating the NDP's distributed on-premises Cisco CUCM phone system to Office 365 Skype for Business and migrating a bespoke citizen-data server workload from VMware to Microsoft Azure. Both engagements required alignment to sensitive security requirements — Protected B equivalent controls for citizen voting information — and were delivered within a compressed three-month window.

challenge.summary: The client was migrating from a traditional distributed on-premise phone system to a fully virtualized Office 365 tenanted system.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:

Server Workload Cloud Migration - New Democratic Party of Canada
